transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I've been struggling with really extreme mood swings for the past five months. I go from having this overwhelming, intense energy to crashing into a really deep depression. It's gotten to the point where I just can't manage these constant shifts on my own anymore.
During these periods of intense energy, have you ever experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things others couldn't, or holding beliefs that others found highly unusual?

No, I've never heard or seen things that others couldn't. However, I have held some beliefs that people around me found really unusual, like feeling that I am an incredibly special person with a grand, unique mission in this world.
Did you ever experience these unusual beliefs during times when your mood was completely normal and stable, or do they only happen when you are feeling very high or low?

No, I only have those beliefs when my mood is extremely high and I'm bursting with energy. When my mood is normal and stable, I don't think like that at all. They only seem to happen during those intense high phases.
When you have these periods of high energy and grand beliefs, how long do they usually last, and have they ever caused serious trouble in your life or required hospitalization?

These high-energy periods usually last for about five months at a time. I have never been hospitalized because of them, but they do make me extremely active and constantly busy with my work and social life.
When you believed you had this grand, unique mission, did you feel it was an absolute, literal truth that no one could convince you otherwise of, and did you take any extreme actions because of it?

Yes, I absolutely believed it was the literal truth, and there was no way anyone could convince me otherwise. That belief drove me to start multiple huge projects all at once and contact as many people as possible to share my purpose with them.
